package rulefixtures

// scenario for range_copy_large_struct: `for _, v := range largeStructSlice` where the struct is > 64 bytes
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
type Rule628PositiveRecord struct {
	ID          int
	Name        string
	Description string
	Tags        []string
	Metadata    map[string]string
	CreatedBy   string
	UpdatedBy   string
	NotBefore   int64
	NotAfter    int64
	Payload     [256]byte
}

func scenario628Positive(items []Rule628PositiveRecord) []string {
	var names []string
	for _, item := range items {
		names = append(names, item.Name)
	}
	return names
}
